<section id="architecture">
<h1>Architecture</h1>
<p>WikiMason keeps deterministic wiki logic in Python and exposes a
filesystem-backed CLI with configurable tool profiles. Runtime bridge
commands are not part of the product surface.</p>
<section id="purpose-and-constraints">
<h2>Purpose and constraints</h2>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Single package at repository root: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">wikimason/</span></code>.</p></li>
<li><p>Python 3.10+.</p></li>
<li><p>Minimal runtime dependencies: Typer, Click, PyYAML, RapidFuzz,
fuzzysearch, and tomli for Python &lt; 3.11.</p></li>
<li><p>Deterministic local filesystem operations.</p></li>
<li><p>No upstream Obsidian CLI dependency.</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="main-layers">
<h2>Main layers</h2>
<dl class="simple myst">
<dt>CLI</dt><dd><p>Typer-based command surface with consistent <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--format</span> <span class="pre">text|json</span></code> output
and structured exit codes.</p>
</dd>
<dt>Operational log</dt><dd><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Wiki/log.md</span></code> is an append-only operational timeline with typed events,
automatic command logging for important change/audit commands, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">log</span> <span class="pre">tail</span></code>,
and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">log</span> <span class="pre">check</span></code> validation.</p>
</dd>
<dt>Config and profile</dt><dd><p>TOML configuration resolved from explicit <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--config</span></code>, local
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">wikimason.toml</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--env</span></code> profiles, and built-in defaults. The active
profile (Markdown, Obsidian, or Logseq) controls on-disk page layout,
frontmatter format, and link rendering.</p>
</dd>
<dt>Filesystem</dt><dd><p>Profile-aware page path resolution, safe vault-relative file operations,
and structured directory layout with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Raw/</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Wiki/</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Schema/</span></code>,
and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">_templates/</span></code>.</p>
</dd>
<dt>Source lifecycle</dt><dd><p>Import raw sources with content hashing and stable <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">source_id</span></code>
assignment. Manifest tracking in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Schema/source-manifest.jsonl</span></code>.
Scan, delta, verify, rehash, and lint operations.</p>
</dd>
<dt>Build and lint</dt><dd><p>Compile <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">AGENTS.md</span></code> from schema, policy, and command metadata.
Generate and validate indexes, catalogs, and command references.
Lint pages for schema compliance, link integrity, and source parity.</p>
</dd>
<dt>Search</dt><dd><p>Catalog-based keyword and fuzzy search across compiled wiki pages.</p>
</dd>
</dl>
</section>
<section id="runtime-workflows">
<h2>Runtime workflows</h2>
<dl class="simple myst">
<dt>Init</dt><dd><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">wikimason</span> <span class="pre">init</span> <span class="pre">&lt;profile&gt;</span> <span class="pre">&lt;path&gt;</span></code> scaffolds a complete vault with
directories, templates, schema files, git hooks, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">AGENTS.md</span></code>.</p>
</dd>
<dt>Source ingest</dt><dd><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">wikimason</span> <span class="pre">source</span> <span class="pre">add</span></code> → <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">source</span> <span class="pre">scan</span></code> → <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">source</span> <span class="pre">delta</span></code> →
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ingest</span> <span class="pre">status</span></code> → <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ingest</span> <span class="pre">plan</span></code> → <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">note</span> <span class="pre">new</span></code> →
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ingest</span> <span class="pre">finish</span></code>.</p>
</dd>
<dt>Vault maintenance</dt><dd><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">wikimason</span> <span class="pre">vault</span> <span class="pre">maintain</span></code> verifies, rebuilds, scans, lints, and
audits all tracked state in one pass, then validates the operational log.</p>
</dd>
</dl>
</section>
<section id="generated-artifacts-and-ownership">
<h2>Generated artifacts and ownership</h2>
<p>These files are generated by WikiMason and should not be hand-edited:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Schema/source-manifest.jsonl</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Schema/command-reference.md</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Schema/frontmatter-schema.md</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Schema/agent-workflow.md</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Wiki/catalog.jsonl</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Wiki/index.md</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Wiki/log.md</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">AGENTS.md</span></code></p></li>
</ul>
</section>
